canonical_project: RackBank Raipur AI Data Center Park / Raipur CEN1 AI GigaCampus
owner: RackBank Datacenters Pvt Ltd (India's first AI SEZ data centre park, developed with Government of Chhattisgarh)
notes: India's first AI data center park: foundation stone laid by CM Vishnu Deo Sai on 3 May 2025 at Sector-22, Nava Raipur (Raipur district); ~Rs 1,000 crore (US$118M) initial investment, 13.5-acre park incl. 2.7-hectare SEZ, site of 14 acres with 100+ acres ROFR (coords 21.1679,81.7601). The Tech Capital reported campus launch May 2025 with plans to scale to 160MW (US$360M over five years); RackBank company page states 20MW to 500MW by 2027 and 2GW roadmap by 2028. First phase launched/under construction; capacity_mw reflects planned campus scale, not current IT load.
